messages.text: Does the harlo labs os work on the nexus S-1
Searched the web · Harlo OS supported miners Nexus S1

I'm Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist.

Probably, but I can't give you a firm yes yet. Harlo OS's supported list includes the Nexus L1, Nexus QX1 and an entry written as 
"Nexus S1.1"
. That name is unclear to me. It could mean revision 1.1 of the 4-chip Nexus S1 (10 TH/s), or it could mean the single-chip Nexus S1-1 (5 TH/s). I won't guess which one it is.

The page also says 
17 models from 7 manufacturers today. More added most weeks. Not on the list yet means not yet, not never.


To get you a clear answer:

1. **Tell me which unit you have.** Is it the S1 (10 TH/s, 4 chips) or the S1-1 (5 TH/s, single chip)? If the board shows a revision number, send that too, or a photo of the board.
2. **Check the flasher yourself:** 
See the current list
 at https://harlolabs.com, open it in Chrome or Edge and look for your exact model in the list. If it's there, it's supported. Install takes about 2 minutes over a USB data cable.
3. **Fastest confirmation:** ask in the Harlo OS channel on our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, and mention @nullhashrate. That's JD, who builds Harlo OS and runs it on his own miners.

Once I know which model you have, I can take you through flashing it.
Searched the web · Harlo OS "Nexus S1" 4 chip BM1373 firmware
Handed to the team · harlolabs.com is not reachable from my tools and the public list is ambiguous; n

I can't confirm it yet for the 4-chip S1, and I'd rather not give you a yes I'm not sure of.

The Harlo OS supported list has an entry called "Nexus S1.1". Nexus also sells a single-chip model called the S1-1, so that entry could mean the S1-1 rather than your 4-chip S1. I can't open the flasher at harlolabs.com from my side to check, so I've sent your question to JD. He builds Harlo OS and will know whether the 4-chip S1 is supported or coming.

**What happens next:**
- The team is offline now and picks this up today at 10am ET. The answer will come to your email.
- **Faster:** ask in the Harlo OS channel on our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, and mention @nullhashrate (that's JD). He's very active there.
- **Check it yourself:** open the flasher at https://harlolabs.com in Chrome or Edge. If the 4-chip S1 is in the model list, you can install it. If it isn't there yet, please don't flash a build made for another model.

Until then your S1 is fine on its stock firmware. Is there anything else on the miner I can help with, like pools or hashrate?
